title: Memnon the Persian
summary: Raleigh names Memnon the Persian in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Memnon, whose Counsell was to waste prouisions and giue ground, and whose Wife Alexander imbraced after Issus. He is not Memnon who came to the defence of Troy. The one-word title would fold onto that record, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
